messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] distance-sampling for birds migration survey
parts:
More detail is needed about your study.  There are many types of "migration surveys"; some where distance sampling can usefully be employed, some not.


For example, consult

Somershoe, S. G.; Twedt, D. J. & Reid, B.
Combining breeding bird survey and distance sampling to estimate density of migrant and breeding birds
Condor, 2006, 108, 691-699

or 


Joshua H. Schmidt, Carol L. McIntyre, Margaret C. MacCluskie, 2013
Accounting for incomplete detection: What are we estimating and how might 
it affect long-term passerine monitoring programs?, 
Biological Conservation, Volume 160, Pages 130-139
Hello, I'm looking for someone who can help me running distance-sampling model for a birds migration survey we conducted TNX
